scenes.cathedral: A drowned monastery remembering that it was once a forest. Enormous ribbed vaults, a burning rose window, roots, silver floodwater, cyan stone and amber spores.
scenes.cosmos: An impossible astronomical instrument grown inside an ammonite. Nested gold orbits collide with turquoise spiral storms. A diagram of a universe whose gravity has become musical.
scenes.kolam: An alien moth becomes a Tamil kolam ritual diagram. Its wings are luminous knotted paths, eyes become rings of tiny flowers, the body becomes a golden spine. Intricate bilateral sacred biology.
